name: GPAC (MP4Box)
role: Packages and inspects MP4, CMAF, DASH and HLS at box level
notes: 2026-11-27: Triage: assess; ffmpeg-ffprobe muxes and can segment but has limited box-level control; mediainfo reports but does not write.

2026-11-27: Lead said Homebrew stable 26.07.0 with release date unverified; the local binary reports 26.07-revrelease. Licence taken from the lead (LGPL-2.1-or-later) and the MP4Box banner (LGPL v2.1+).

2026-11-27: Fixture partial: MP4Box -dash with three inputs aborts in about 1 run in 5 (retry in run.sh); base MP4 and init segments carry a wall-clock track modification time that -time/-mtime do not pin.

evidence.result: ffmpeg testsrc+sine MP4 (10 s) plus WebVTT and 2 chapters via MP4Box: 3 tracks (avc1, mp4a, wvtt eng), chapters Intro 0 s and Middle 5 s; -dash 4000 gives 3 segments per track, video 100/100/50 packets (4, 4, 2 s), MPD max segment PT4S. KNOWN FAIL: base.mp4 and 3 init segments differ across runs (modification time); .m4s and MPD identical. MP4Box -dash crashed in about 1 run in 5.
evidence.scope: MP4Box 26.07 on macOS arm64: tracks, chapters, DASH segment counts pass; byte-identical reruns FAIL for base MP4 and init segments (m4s, MPD identical); intermittent -dash crash; no HLS or players.

summary: Multimedia framework whose MP4Box and gpac CLIs package and inspect MP4, CMAF, DASH and HLS: fragmenting, segmenting, adding subtitle and chapter tracks, and dumping box structure. FFmpeg muxes; GPAC gives box-level control for adaptive-streaming delivery.
use_when: Fragment an MP4 into DASH segments and a manifest with pinned segment duration
Add a WebVTT subtitle track or chapters to an MP4, or dump its box structure
avoid_when: Need to decode or encode pictures or sound: FFmpeg
Need a byte-reproducible MP4 for hashing: the track modification time is not pinnable

assessment.rationale: Lead reports a push on 2026-11-24 and Homebrew stable 26.07; the local MP4Box banner confirms 26.07-revrelease and LGPL v2.1+. Fills the box-level packaging and DASH gap beside ffmpeg-ffprobe and mediainfo; release date not independently checked.
